definitions.ask: When `tables_to_lists=false`, should the linker get an explicit rule to keep the lead's tables as tables?
definitions.why: The off default exists to show real tables in the PDF; a free linker may convert some

choices.label: Add a short "Keep tables as tables" bullet so default runs reliably publish real tables
Restore the pre-conversion wording; the linker may still turn some tables into lists
